   660→  const state = Instance.state(async () => {
   661→    using _ = log.time("state")
   662→    const config = await Config.get()
   663→    const modelsDev = await ModelsDev.get()
   664→    const database = mapValues(modelsDev, fromModelsDevProvider)
   665→
   666→    const disabled = new Set(config.disabled_providers ?? [])
   667→    const enabled = config.enabled_providers ? new Set(config.enabled_providers) : null
   668→
   669→    function isProviderAllowed(providerID: string): boolean {
   670→      if (enabled && !enabled.has(providerID)) return false
   671→      if (disabled.has(providerID)) return false
   672→      return true
   673→    }
   674→
   675→    const providers: { [providerID: string]: Info } = {}
   676→    const languages = new Map<string, LanguageModelV2>()
   677→    const modelLoaders: {
   678→      [providerID: string]: CustomModelLoader
   679→    } = {}
   680→    const sdk = new Map<number, SDK>()
   681→
   682→    log.info("init")
   683→
   684→    const configProviders = Object.entries(config.provider ?? {})
   685→
   686→    // Add GitHub Copilot Enterprise provider that inherits from GitHub Copilot
   687→    if (database["github-copilot"]) {
   688→      const githubCopilot = database["github-copilot"]
   689→      database["github-copilot-enterprise"] = {
   690→        ...githubCopilot,
   691→        id: "github-copilot-enterprise",
   692→        name: "GitHub Copilot Enterprise",
   693→        models: mapValues(githubCopilot.models, (model) => ({
   694→          ...model,
   695→          providerID: "github-copilot-enterprise",
   696→        })),
   697→      }
   698→    }
   699→
   700→    function mergeProvider(providerID: string, provider: Partial<Info>) {
   701→      const existing = providers[providerID]
   702→      if (existing) {
   703→        // @ts-expect-error
   704→        providers[providerID] = mergeDeep(existing, provider)
   705→        return
   706→      }
   707→      const match = database[providerID]
   708→      if (!match) return
   709→      // @ts-expect-error
   710→      providers[providerID] = mergeDeep(match, provider)
   711→    }
   712→
   713→    // extend database from config
   714→    for (const [providerID, provider] of configProviders) {
   715→      const existing = database[providerID]
   716→      const parsed: Info = {
   717→        id: providerID,
   718→        name: provider.name ?? existing?.name ?? providerID,
   719→        env: provider.env ?? existing?.env ?? [],
   720→        options: mergeDeep(existing?.options ?? {}, provider.options ?? {}),
   721→        source: "config",
   722→        models: existing?.models ?? {},
   723→      }
   724→
   725→      for (const [modelID, model] of Object.entries(provider.models ?? {})) {
   726→        const existingModel = parsed.models[model.id ?? modelID]
   727→        const name = iife(() => {
   728→          if (model.name) return model.name
   729→          if (model.id && model.id !== modelID) return modelID
   730→          return existingModel?.name ?? modelID
   731→        })
   732→        const parsedModel: Model = {
   733→          id: modelID,
   734→          api: {
   735→            id: model.id ?? existingModel?.api.id ?? modelID,
   736→            npm:
   737→              model.provider?.npm ??
   738→              provider.npm ??
   739→              existingModel?.api.npm ??
   740→              modelsDev[providerID]?.npm ??
   741→              "@ai-sdk/openai-compatible",
   742→            url: provider?.api ?? existingModel?.api.url ?? modelsDev[providerID]?.api,
   743→          },
   744→          status: model.status ?? existingModel?.status ?? "active",
   745→          name,
   746→          providerID,
   747→          capabilities: {
   748→            temperature: model.temperature ?? existingModel?.capabilities.temperature ?? false,
   749→            reasoning: model.reasoning ?? existingModel?.capabilities.reasoning ?? false,
   750→            attachment: model.attachment ?? existingModel?.capabilities.attachment ?? false,
   751→            toolcall: model.tool_call ?? existingModel?.capabilities.toolcall ?? true,
   752→            input: {
   753→              text: model.modalities?.input?.includes("text") ?? existingModel?.capabilities.input.text ?? true,
   754→              audio: model.modalities?.input?.includes("audio") ?? existingModel?.capabilities.input.audio ?? false,
   755→              image: model.modalities?.input?.includes("image") ?? existingModel?.capabilities.input.image ?? false,
   756→              video: model.modalities?.input?.includes("video") ?? existingModel?.capabilities.input.video ?? false,
   757→              pdf: model.modalities?.input?.includes("pdf") ?? existingModel?.capabilities.input.pdf ?? false,
   758→            },
   759→            output: {
   760→              text: model.modalities?.output?.includes("text") ?? existingModel?.capabilities.output.text ?? true,
   761→              audio: model.modalities?.output?.includes("audio") ?? existingModel?.capabilities.output.audio ?? false,
   762→              image: model.modalities?.output?.includes("image") ?? existingModel?.capabilities.output.image ?? false,
   763→              video: model.modalities?.output?.includes("video") ?? existingModel?.capabilities.output.video ?? false,
   764→              pdf: model.modalities?.output?.includes("pdf") ?? existingModel?.capabilities.output.pdf ?? false,
   765→            },
   766→            interleaved: model.interleaved ?? false,
   767→          },
   768→          cost: {
   769→            input: model?.cost?.input ?? existingModel?.cost?.input ?? 0,
   770→            output: model?.cost?.output ?? existingModel?.cost?.output ?? 0,
   771→            cache: {
   772→              read: model?.cost?.cache_read ?? existingModel?.cost?.cache.read ?? 0,
   773→              write: model?.cost?.cache_write ?? existingModel?.cost?.cache.write ?? 0,
   774→            },
   775→          },
   776→          options: mergeDeep(existingModel?.options ?? {}, model.options ?? {}),
   777→          limit: {
   778→            context: model.limit?.context ?? existingModel?.limit?.context ?? 0,
   779→            output: model.limit?.output ?? existingModel?.limit?.output ?? 0,
   780→          },
   781→          headers: mergeDeep(existingModel?.headers ?? {}, model.headers ?? {}),
   782→          family: model.family ?? existingModel?.family ?? "",
   783→          release_date: model.release_date ?? existingModel?.release_date ?? "",
   784→          variants: {},
   785→        }
   786→        const merged = mergeDeep(ProviderTransform.variants(parsedModel), model.variants ?? {})
   787→        parsedModel.variants = mapValues(
   788→          pickBy(merged, (v) => !v.disabled),
   789→          (v) => omit(v, ["disabled"]),
   790→        )
   791→        parsed.models[modelID] = parsedModel
   792→      }
   793→      database[providerID] = parsed
   794→    }
   795→
   796→    // load env
   797→    const env = Env.all()
   798→    for (const [providerID, provider] of Object.entries(database)) {
   799→      if (disabled.has(providerID)) continue
   800→      const apiKey = provider.env.map((item) => env[item]).find(Boolean)
   801→      if (!apiKey) continue
   802→      mergeProvider(providerID, {
   803→        source: "env",
   804→        key: provider.env.length === 1 ? apiKey : undefined,
   805→      })
   806→    }
   807→
   808→    // load apikeys
   809→    for (const [providerID, provider] of Object.entries(await Auth.all())) {
   810→      if (disabled.has(providerID)) continue
   811→      if (provider.type === "api") {
   812→        mergeProvider(providerID, {
   813→          source: "api",
   814→          key: provider.key,
   815→        })
   816→      }
   817→    }
   818→
   819→    for (const plugin of await Plugin.list()) {
   820→      if (!plugin.auth) continue
   821→      const providerID = plugin.auth.provider
   822→      if (disabled.has(providerID)) continue
   823→
   824→      // For github-copilot plugin, check if auth exists for either github-copilot or github-copilot-enterprise
   825→      let hasAuth = false
   826→      const auth = await Auth.get(providerID)
   827→      if (auth) hasAuth = true
   828→
   829→      // Special handling for github-copilot: also check for enterprise auth
   830→      if (providerID === "github-copilot" && !hasAuth) {
   831→        const enterpriseAuth = await Auth.get("github-copilot-enterprise")
   832→        if (enterpriseAuth) hasAuth = true
   833→      }
   834→
   835→      if (!hasAuth) continue
   836→      if (!plugin.auth.loader) continue
   837→
   838→      // Load for the main provider if auth exists
   839→      if (auth) {
   840→        const options = await plugin.auth.loader(() => Auth.get(providerID) as any, database[plugin.auth.provider])
   841→        mergeProvider(plugin.auth.provider, {
   842→          source: "custom",
   843→          options: options,
   844→        })
   845→      }
   846→
   847→      // If this is github-copilot plugin, also register for github-copilot-enterprise if auth exists
   848→      if (providerID === "github-copilot") {
   849→        const enterpriseProviderID = "github-copilot-enterprise"
   850→        if (!disabled.has(enterpriseProviderID)) {
   851→          const enterpriseAuth = await Auth.get(enterpriseProviderID)
   852→          if (enterpriseAuth) {
   853→            const enterpriseOptions = await plugin.auth.loader(
   854→              () => Auth.get(enterpriseProviderID) as any,
   855→              database[enterpriseProviderID],
   856→            )
   857→            mergeProvider(enterpriseProviderID, {
   858→              source: "custom",
   859→              options: enterpriseOptions,
   860→            })
   861→          }
   862→        }
   863→      }
   864→    }
   865→
   866→    for (const [providerID, fn] of Object.entries(CUSTOM_LOADERS)) {
   867→      if (disabled.has(providerID)) continue
   868→      const result = await fn(database[providerID])
   869→      if (result && (result.autoload || providers[providerID])) {
   870→        if (result.getModel) modelLoaders[providerID] = result.getModel
   871→        mergeProvider(providerID, {
   872→          source: "custom",
   873→          options: result.options,
   874→        })
   875→      }
   876→    }
   877→
   878→    // load config
   879→    for (const [providerID, provider] of configProviders) {
   880→      const partial: Partial<Info> = { source: "config" }
   881→      if (provider.env) partial.env = provider.env
   882→      if (provider.name) partial.name = provider.name
   883→      if (provider.options) partial.options = provider.options
   884→      mergeProvider(providerID, partial)
   885→    }
   886→
   887→    for (const [providerID, provider] of Object.entries(providers)) {
   888→      if (!isProviderAllowed(providerID)) {
   889→        delete providers[providerID]
   890→        continue
   891→      }
   892→
   893→      if (providerID === "github-copilot" || providerID === "github-copilot-enterprise") {
   894→        provider.models = mapValues(provider.models, (model) => ({
   895→          ...model,
   896→          api: {
   897→            ...model.api,
   898→            npm: "@ai-sdk/github-copilot",
   899→          },
   900→        }))
   901→      }
   902→
   903→      const configProvider = config.provider?.[providerID]
   904→
   905→      for (const [modelID, model] of Object.entries(provider.models)) {
   906→        model.api.id = model.api.id ?? model.id ?? modelID
   907→        if (modelID === "gpt-5-chat-latest" || (providerID === "openrouter" && modelID === "openai/gpt-5-chat"))
   908→          delete provider.models[modelID]
   909→        if (model.status === "alpha" && !Flag.OPENCODE_ENABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_MODELS) delete provider.models[modelID]
   910→        if (model.status === "deprecated") delete provider.models[modelID]
   911→        if (
   912→          (configProvider?.blacklist && configProvider.blacklist.includes(modelID)) ||
   913→          (configProvider?.whitelist && !configProvider.whitelist.includes(modelID))
   914→        )
   915→          delete provider.models[modelID]
   916→
   917→        // Filter out disabled variants from config
   918→        const configVariants = configProvider?.models?.[modelID]?.variants
   919→        if (configVariants && model.variants) {
   920→          const merged = mergeDeep(model.variants, configVariants)
   921→          model.variants = mapValues(
   922→            pickBy(merged, (v) => !v.disabled),
   923→            (v) => omit(v, ["disabled"]),
   924→          )
   925→        }
   926→      }
   927→
   928→      if (Object.keys(provider.models).length === 0) {
   929→        delete providers[providerID]
   930→        continue
   931→      }
   932→
   933→      log.info("found", { providerID })
   934→    }
   935→
   936→    return {
   937→      models: languages,
   938→      providers,
   939→      sdk,
   940→      modelLoaders,
   941→    }
   942→  })

   948→  async function getSDK(model: Model) {
   949→    try {
   950→      using _ = log.time("getSDK", {
   951→        providerID: model.providerID,
   952→      })
   953→      const s = await state()
   954→      const provider = s.providers[model.providerID]
   955→      const options = { ...provider.options }
   956→
   957→      if (model.api.npm.includes("@ai-sdk/openai-compatible") && options["includeUsage"] !== false) {
   958→        options["includeUsage"] = true
   959→      }
   960→
   961→      if (!options["baseURL"]) options["baseURL"] = model.api.url
   962→      if (options["apiKey"] === undefined && provider.key) options["apiKey"] = provider.key
   963→      if (model.headers)
   964→        options["headers"] = {
   965→          ...options["headers"],
   966→          ...model.headers,
   967→        }
   968→
   969→      const key = Bun.hash.xxHash32(JSON.stringify({ npm: model.api.npm, options }))
   970→      const existing = s.sdk.get(key)
   971→      if (existing) return existing
   972→
   973→      const customFetch = options["fetch"]
   974→
   975→      options["fetch"] = async (input: any, init?: BunFetchRequestInit) => {
   976→        // Preserve custom fetch if it exists, wrap it with timeout logic
   977→        const fetchFn = customFetch ?? fetch
   978→        const opts = init ?? {}
   979→
   980→        if (options["timeout"] !== undefined && options["timeout"] !== null) {
   981→          const signals: AbortSignal[] = []
   982→          if (opts.signal) signals.push(opts.signal)
   983→          if (options["timeout"] !== false) signals.push(AbortSignal.timeout(options["timeout"]))
   984→
   985→          const combined = signals.length > 1 ? AbortSignal.any(signals) : signals[0]
   986→
   987→          opts.signal = combined
   988→        }
   989→
   990→        return fetchFn(input, {
   991→          ...opts,
   992→          // @ts-ignore see here: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/issues/16682
   993→          timeout: false,
   994→        })
   995→      }
   996→
   997→      // Special case: google-vertex-anthropic uses a subpath import
   998→      const bundledKey =
   999→        model.providerID === "google-vertex-anthropic" ? "@ai-sdk/google-vertex/anthropic" : model.api.npm
  1000→      const bundledFn = BUNDLED_PROVIDERS[bundledKey]
  1001→      if (bundledFn) {
  1002→        log.info("using bundled provider", { providerID: model.providerID, pkg: bundledKey })
  1003→        const loaded = bundledFn({
  1004→          name: model.providerID,
  1005→          ...options,
  1006→        })
  1007→        s.sdk.set(key, loaded)
  1008→        return loaded as SDK
  1009→      }
  1010→
  1011→      let installedPath: string
  1012→      if (!model.api.npm.startsWith("file://")) {
  1013→        installedPath = await BunProc.install(model.api.npm, "latest")
  1014→      } else {
  1015→        log.info("loading local provider", { pkg: model.api.npm })
  1016→        installedPath = model.api.npm
  1017→      }
  1018→
  1019→      const mod = await import(installedPath)
  1020→
  1021→      const fn = mod[Object.keys(mod).find((key) => key.startsWith("create"))!]
  1022→      const loaded = fn({
  1023→        name: model.providerID,
  1024→        ...options,
  1025→      })
  1026→      s.sdk.set(key, loaded)
  1027→      return loaded as SDK
  1028→    } catch (e) {
  1029→      throw new InitError({ providerID: model.providerID }, { cause: e })
  1030→    }
  1031→  }

  1037→  export async function getModel(providerID: string, modelID: string) {
  1038→    const s = await state()
  1039→    const provider = s.providers[providerID]
  1040→    if (!provider) {
  1041→      const availableProviders = Object.keys(s.providers)
  1042→      const matches = fuzzysort.go(providerID, availableProviders, { limit: 3, threshold: -10000 })
  1043→      const suggestions = matches.map((m) => m.target)
  1044→      throw new ModelNotFoundError({ providerID, modelID, suggestions })
  1045→    }
  1046→
  1047→    const info = provider.models[modelID]
  1048→    if (!info) {
  1049→      const availableModels = Object.keys(provider.models)
  1050→      const matches = fuzzysort.go(modelID, availableModels, { limit: 3, threshold: -10000 })
  1051→      const suggestions = matches.map((m) => m.target)
  1052→      throw new ModelNotFoundError({ providerID, modelID, suggestions })
  1053→    }
  1054→    return info
  1055→  }

  1057→  export async function getLanguage(model: Model): Promise<LanguageModelV2> {
  1058→    const s = await state()
  1059→    const key = `${model.providerID}/${model.id}`
  1060→    if (s.models.has(key)) return s.models.get(key)!
  1061→
  1062→    const provider = s.providers[model.providerID]
  1063→    const sdk = await getSDK(model)
  1064→
  1065→    try {
  1066→      const language = s.modelLoaders[model.providerID]
  1067→        ? await s.modelLoaders[model.providerID](sdk, model.api.id, provider.options)
  1068→        : sdk.languageModel(model.api.id)
  1069→      s.models.set(key, language)
  1070→      return language
  1071→    } catch (e) {
  1072→      if (e instanceof NoSuchModelError)
  1073→        throw new ModelNotFoundError(
  1074→          {
  1075→            modelID: model.id,
  1076→            providerID: model.providerID,
  1077→          },
  1078→          { cause: e },
  1079→        )
  1080→      throw e
  1081→    }
  1082→  }

  1086→    const provider = s.providers[providerID]
  1087→    if (!provider) return undefined
  1088→    for (const item of query) {

  1099→  export async function getSmallModel(providerID: string) {
  1100→    const cfg = await Config.get()
  1101→
  1102→    if (cfg.small_model) {
  1103→      const parsed = parseModel(cfg.small_model)
  1104→      return getModel(parsed.providerID, parsed.modelID)
  1105→    }
  1106→
  1107→    const provider = await state().then((state) => state.providers[providerID])
  1108→    if (provider) {
  1109→      let priority = [
  1110→        "claude-haiku-4-5",
  1111→        "claude-haiku-4.5",
  1112→        "3-5-haiku",
  1113→        "3.5-haiku",
  1114→        "gemini-3-flash",
  1115→        "gemini-2.5-flash",
  1116→        "gpt-5-nano",
  1117→      ]
  1118→      if (providerID.startsWith("opencode")) {
  1119→        priority = ["gpt-5-nano"]
  1120→      }
  1121→      if (providerID.startsWith("github-copilot")) {
  1122→        // prioritize free models for github copilot
  1123→        priority = ["gpt-5-mini", "claude-haiku-4.5", ...priority]
  1124→      }
  1125→      for (const item of priority) {
  1126→        for (const model of Object.keys(provider.models)) {
  1127→          if (model.includes(item)) return getModel(providerID, model)
  1128→        }
  1129→      }
  1130→    }
  1131→
  1132→    // Check if opencode provider is available before using it
  1133→    const opencodeProvider = await state().then((state) => state.providers["opencode"])
  1134→    if (opencodeProvider && opencodeProvider.models["gpt-5-nano"]) {
  1135→      return getModel("opencode", "gpt-5-nano")
  1136→    }
  1137→
  1138→    return undefined
  1139→  }

  1142→  export function sort(models: Model[]) {

  1157→      .then((x) => x.find((p) => !cfg.provider || Object.keys(cfg.provider).includes(p.id)))

  1162→      providerID: provider.id,
  1163→      modelID: model.id,

    31→## 核心接口
    32→
    33→### Tool.Info - 工具定义接口

    36→// packages/opencode/src/tool/tool.ts

    38→  id: string
    39→  init: (ctx?: InitContext) => Promise<{

    91→## 工具注册机制

    96→// packages/opencode/src/tool/registry.ts
    97→export namespace ToolRegistry {

   109→### 工具加载流程

   116→// 内置工具列表

   129→  TodoReadTool,   // 读取待办事项
   130→  WebSearchTool, // 网页搜索
   131→  CodeSearchTool,   // 代码搜索

   163→
   164→## 权限系统
   165→
   166→### 权限请求流程
   167→
   168→每个工具在执行敏感操作前，必须通过 `ctx.ask()` 请求权限：
   169→
   170→```typescript
   171→await ctx.ask({
   172→permission: "bash",      // 权限类型
   173→  patterns: ["git status"],     // 具体操作模式
   174→  always: ["git*"],      // "始终允许"的模式
   175→  metadata: { ... },  // 展示给用户的信息
   176→})
   177→```
   178→
   179→### 权限规则 (PermissionNext.Rule)
   180→
   181→```typescript
   182→type Rule = {
   183→  permission: string   // 权限类型: bash, edit, read, glob, grep, etc.
   184→  pattern: string      // 匹配模式（支持通配符）
   185→  action: "allow" | "deny" | "ask"
   186→}
   187→```
   188→
   189→### 权限评估逻辑
   190→
   191→```typescript
   192→// packages/opencode/src/permission/next.ts
   193→export function evaluate(permission: string, pattern: string, ...rulesets: Ruleset[]): Rule {
   194→  const merged = merge(...rulesets)
   195→  // 查找最后一个匹配的规则（后定义的规则优先级更高）
   196→  const match = merged.findLast(
   197→    (rule) => Wildcard.match(permission, rule.permission) &&
   198→              Wildcard.match(pattern, rule.pattern),
   199→  )
   200→  return match ?? { action: "ask", permission, pattern: "*" }
   201→}
   202→```
   203→
   204→### 权限类型
   205→
   206→| 权限类型 | 描述 | 对应工具 |
   207→|---------|------|---------|
   208→| `bash` | 执行 Shell 命令 | BashTool |
   209→| `edit` | 编辑/写入文件 | EditTool, WriteTool, PatchTool |
   210→| `read` | 读取文件 | ReadTool |
   211→| `glob` | 文件搜索 | GlobTool |
   212→| `grep` | 内容搜索 | GrepTool |
   213→| `webfetch` | 获取网页 | WebFetchTool |
   214→| `task` | 启动子 Agent | TaskTool |
   215→| `external_directory` | 访问项目外目录 | 多个工具共用 |
   216→

   218→
   219→## 内置工具详解
   220→
   221→### BashTool - Shell 命令执行
   222→
   223→**文件**: `packages/opencode/src/tool/bash.ts`
   224→
   225→**核心特性**:
   226→- 使用 Tree-sitter 解析命令，提取目录和命令模式
   227→- 自动检测危险操作（cd, rm, cp 等）并请求权限
   228→- 支持超时控制（默认 2 分钟）
   229→- 实时输出流式更新
   230→
   231→**关键实现**:
   232→
   233→```typescript
   234→// 使用 Tree-sitter 解析 Bash 命令
   235→const parser = lazy(async () => {
   236→  const { Parser } = await import("web-tree-sitter")
   237→  // ... 初始化 Bash 语言解析器
   238→})
   239→
   240→// 解析命令提取操作模式
   241→const tree = await parser().then((p) => p.parse(params.command))
   242→for (const node of tree.rootNode.descendantsOfType("command")) {
   243→  // 提取命令名和参数
   244→  // 检查是否涉及项目外目录
   245→}
   246→
   247→// 执行命令
   248→const proc = spawn(params.command, {
   249→  shell,
   250→  cwd,
   251→  stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe"],
   252→})
   253→
   254→// 实时更新输出
   255→proc.stdout?.on("data", (chunk) => {
   256→  output += chunk.toString()
   257→  ctx.metadata({ metadata: { output, description } })
   258→})
   259→```
   260→
   261→### EditTool - 文件编辑
   262→
   263→**文件**: `packages/opencode/src/tool/edit.ts`
   264→
   265→**核心特性**:
   266→- 多种模糊匹配策略（容错性强）
   267→- 集成 LSP 诊断
   268→- 自动生成 diff
   269→
   270→**替换器链（Replacer Chain）**:
   271→
   272→```typescript
   273→const replacers = [
   274→  SimpleReplacer,              // 精确匹配
   275→  LineTrimmedReplacer,   // 忽略行首尾空白
   276→  BlockAnchorReplacer,  // 首尾行锚定匹配
   277→  WhitespaceNormalizedReplacer,// 空白标准化
   278→  IndentationFlexibleReplacer, // 缩进灵活匹配
   279→  EscapeNormalizedReplacer,    // 转义字符标准化
   280→  TrimmedBoundaryReplacer,     // 边界裁剪匹配
   281→  ContextAwareReplacer,        // 上下文感知匹配
   282→  MultiOccurrenceReplacer,     // 多处匹配
   283→]
   284→
   285→// 依次尝试每个替换器，直到找到匹配
   286→for (const replacer of replacers) {
   287→  for (const search of replacer(content, oldString)) {
   288→    // 找到匹配，执行替换
   289→  }
   290→}
   291→```
   292→
   293→**BlockAnchorReplacer 算法**:
   294→1. 用搜索块的首行和末行作为"锚点"
   295→2. 在原文件中找到匹配的锚点对
   296→3. 使用 Levenshtein 距离计算中间行的相似度
   297→4. 选择相似度最高的候选块
   298→
   299→### ReadTool - 文件读取
   300→
   301→**文件**: `packages/opencode/src/tool/read.ts`
   302→
   303→**核心特性**:
   304→- 支持图片和 PDF（返回 base64 附件）
   305→- 自动检测二进制文件
   306→- 支持偏移量和行数限制
   307→- 输出带行号格式
   308→
   309→```typescript
   310→// 图片/PDF 处理
   311→if (isImage || isPdf) {
   312→  return {
   313→    attachments: [{
   314→      type: "file",
   315→      mime,
   316→      url: `data:${mime};base64,${Buffer.from(await file.bytes()).toString("base64")}`,
   317→    }],
   318→  }
   319→}
   320→
   321→// 二进制文件检测
   322→async function isBinaryFile(filepath: string, file: Bun.BunFile): Promise<boolean> {
   323→  // 1. 检查文件扩展名（.zip, .exe 等）
   324→  // 2. 检查前 4096 字节中的 null 字符
   325→  // 3. 检查非打印字符比例（>30% 视为二进制）
   326→}
   327→
   328→// 输出格式
   329→// 00001| 第一行内容
   330→// 00002| 第二行内容
   331→```
   332→
   333→### TaskTool - 子 Agent 任务
   334→
   335→**文件**: `packages/opencode/src/tool/task.ts`
   336→
   337→**核心特性**:
   338→- 创建子会话执行复杂任务
   339→- 支持不同类型的子 Agent
   340→- 实时同步工具调用状态
   341→
   342→```typescript
   343→// 创建子会话
   344→const session = await Session.create({
   345→  parentID: ctx.sessionID,
   346→  title: params.description + ` (@${agent.name} subagent)`,
   347→  permission: [
   348→    // 子 Agent 默认禁用某些工具
   349→    { permission: "todowrite", pattern: "*", action: "deny" },
   350→    { permission: "todoread", pattern: "*", action: "deny" },
   351→  ],
   352→})
   353→
   354→// 执行子任务
   355→const result = await SessionPrompt.prompt({
   356→  sessionID: session.id,
   357→  model: { modelID, providerID },
   358→  agent: agent.name,
   359→  parts: promptParts,
   360→})
   361→```
   362→
   363→### GlobTool / GrepTool - 文件搜索
   364→
   365→**文件**: `packages/opencode/src/tool/glob.ts`, `packages/opencode/src/tool/grep.ts`
   366→
   367→两者都基于 `ripgrep`：
   368→
   369→```typescript
   370→// GlobTool - 文件名匹配
   371→for await (const file of Ripgrep.files({
   372→  cwd: search,
   373→  glob: [params.pattern],
   374→})) {
   375→files.push({ path: full, mtime: stats })
   376→}
   377→// 按修改时间排序
   378→files.sort((a, b) => b.mtime - a.mtime)
   379→
   380→// GrepTool - 内容搜索
   381→const args = ["-nH", "--hidden", "--follow", "--field-match-separator=|", "--regexp", params.pattern]
   382→const proc = Bun.spawn([rgPath, ...args])
   383→```
   384→
   385→### WebFetchTool - 网页获取
   386→
   387→**文件**: `packages/opencode/src/tool/webfetch.ts`
   388→
   389→**核心特性**:
   390→- 支持 text/markdown/html 格式
   391→- HTML 自动转 Markdown（使用 Turndown）
   392→- 响应大小限制（5MB）
   393→
   394→```typescript
   395→// HTML 转 Markdown
   396→function convertHTMLToMarkdown(html: string): string {
   397→  const turndownService = new TurndownService({
   398→    headingStyle: "atx",
   399→    codeBlockStyle: "fenced",
   400→  })
   401→  turndownService.remove(["script", "style", "meta", "link"])
   402→  return turndownService.turndown(html)
   403→}
   404→```
   405→
   406→---
   407→
   408→## 输出截断机制
   409→
   410→**文件**: `packages/opencode/src/tool/truncation.ts`
   411→
   412→当工具输出过大时，自动截断并保存完整内容到文件：
   413→
   414→```typescript
   415→export namespace Truncate {
   416→  export const MAX_LINES = 2000
   417→  export const MAX_BYTES = 50 * 1024  // 50KB
   418→
   419→  export async function output(text: string, options: Options, agent?: Agent.Info): Promise<Result> {
   420→    // 检查是否需要截断
   421→    if (lines.length <= maxLines && totalBytes <= maxBytes) {
   422→      return { content: text, truncated: false }
   423→    }
   424→
   425→    // 保存完整输出到文件
   426→    const filepath = path.join(DIR, Identifier.ascending("tool"))
   427→    await Bun.write(filepath, text)
   428→
   429→    // 返回截断后的内容 + 提示
   430→    const hint = hasTaskTool(agent)
   431→      ? `Full output saved to: ${filepath}\nUse Task tool to have explore agent process this file.`
   432→      : `Full output saved to: ${filepath}\nUse Grep/Read with offset/limit to view sections.`
   433→
   434→    return { content: preview + hint, truncated: true, outputPath: filepath }
   435→  }
   436→}
   437→```
   438→
   439→---
   440→
   441→## 自定义工具开发
   442→
   443→### 方式一：配置目录工具
   444→
   445→在项目 `.opencode/tool/` 或 `~/.config/opencode/tool/` 下创建工具文件：
   446→
   447→```typescript
   448→// .opencode/tool/mytool.ts
   449→import { tool } from "@opencode-ai/plugin"
   450→
   451→export default tool({
   452→description: "我的自定义工具",
   453→  args: {
   454→    input: tool.schema.string().describe("输入参数"),
   455→  },
   456→  async execute(args, ctx) {
   457→    // 请求权限（可选）
   458→    await ctx.ask({
   459→      permission: "mytool",
   460→      patterns: [args.input],
   461→      always: ["*"],
   462→      metadata: {},
   463→    })
   464→
   465→    // 执行逻辑
   466→    return `处理结果: ${args.input}`
   467→  },
   468→})
   469→```
   470→
   471→### 方式二：插件工具
   472→
   473→```typescript
   474→// my-plugin.ts
   475→import type { Plugin } from "@opencode-ai/plugin"
   476→
   477→const plugin: Plugin = async (input) => {
   478→  return {
   479→    tool: {
   480→      "my-tool": {
   481→        description: "插件工具",
   482→      args: {
   483→          param: input.$.z.string(),
   484→        },
   485→        async execute(args, ctx) {
   486→   return `结果: ${args.param}`
   487→   },
   488→      },
   489→    },
   490→  }
   491→}
   492→
   493→export default plugin
   494→```
   495→
   496→### ToolContext API
   497→
   498→```typescript
   499→interface ToolContext {
   500→  sessionID: string
   501→  messageID: string
   502→  agent: string
   503→  abort: AbortSignal
   504→
   505→  // 更新工具状态（实时反馈给 UI）
   506→  metadata(input: { title?: string; metadata?: any }): void
   507→
   508→  // 请求用户授权
   509→  ask(input: {
   510→    permission: string // 权限类型
   511→    patterns: string[]      // 操作模式

   518→---
   519→
   520→## 插件系统集成
   521→
   522→### 插件 Hooks
   523→
   524→插件可以通过 hooks 介入工具执行流程：
   525→
   526→```typescript
   527→interface Hooks {
   528→  // 工具执行前
   529→  "tool.execute.before"?: (
   530→    input: { tool: string; sessionID: string; callID: string },
   531→    output: { args: any },
   532→  ) => Promise<void>
   533→
   534→// 工具执行后
   535→  "tool.execute.after"?: (
   536→    input: { tool: string; sessionID: string; callID: string },
   537→    output: { title: string; output: string; metadata: any },
   538→  ) => Promise<void>
   539→
   540→  // 权限请求
   541→  "permission.ask"?: (
   542→    input: Permission,
   543→    output: { status: "ask" | "deny" | "allow" },
   544→  ) => Promise<void>
   545→}
   546→```
   547→
   548→### 工具从插件加载
   549→
   550→```typescript
   551→// packages/opencode/src/tool/registry.ts
   552→function fromPlugin(id: string, def: ToolDefinition): Tool.Info {
   553→  return {
   554→    id,
   555→    init: async (initCtx) => ({
   556→      parameters: z.object(def.args),
   557→      description: def.description,
   558→      execute: async (args, ctx) => {
   559→        const result = await def.execute(args, ctx)
   560→        const out = await Truncate.output(result, {}, initCtx?.agent)
   561→        return {
   562→          title: "",
   563→          output: out.truncated ? out.content : result,
   564→  metadata: { truncated: out.truncated },
   565→        }
   566→      },
   567→    }),
   568→  }
   569→}
   570→```
   571→
   572→---
   573→
   574→## 总结
   575→
   576→OpenCode 工具系统的核心设计原则：
   577→
   578→1. **类型安全**: 使用 Zod schema 定义参数，确保运行时类型安全
   579→2. **权限控制**: 所有敏感操作都需要用户授权
   580→3. **容错性**: 编辑工具使用多种匹配策略，提高成功率
   581→4. **可扩展**: 支持配置目录工具和插件工具
   582→5. **实时反馈**: 通过 `ctx.metadata()` 实时更新执行状态
   583→6. **输出管理**: 自动截断大输出，保存完整内容供后续访问
   584→
   585→关键源文件：
   586→- `packages/opencode/src/tool/tool.ts` - 核心接口定义
   587→- `packages/opencode/src/tool/registry.ts` - 工具注册中心
   588→- `packages/opencode/src/permission/next.ts` - 权限系统
   589→- `packages/plugin/src/tool.ts` - 插件工具定义
   590→

     1→# OpenCode 工具系统架构
     2→
     3→本文档详细介绍 OpenCode 中工具（Tool）系统的实现原理和架构设计。
     4→
     5→## 目录
     6→
     7→1. [概述](#概述)
     8→2. [核心接口](#核心接口)
     9→3. [工具注册机制](#工具注册机制)
    10→4. [权限系统](#权限系统)
    11→5. [内置工具详解](#内置工具详解)
    12→6. [输出截断机制](#输出截断机制)
    13→7. [自定义工具开发](#自定义工具开发)
    14→8. [插件系统集成](#插件系统集成)
    15→
    16→---
    17→
    18→## 概述
    19→
    20→OpenCode 的工具系统是一个可扩展的框架，允许 AI Agent 执行各种操作：文件读写、命令执行、代码搜索等。整个系统围绕以下核心概念构建：
    21→
    22→- **Tool.Info**: 工具定义接口
    23→- **Tool.Context**: 工具执行上下文
    24→- **ToolRegistry**: 工具注册中心
    25→- **PermissionNext**: 权限控制系统
    26→
    27→源码位置: `packages/opencode/src/tool/`
    28→
    29→---
    30→
    31→## 核心接口
    32→
    33→### Tool.Info - 工具定义接口
    34→
    35→```typescript
    36→// packages/opencode/src/tool/tool.ts
    37→export interface Info<Parameters extends z.ZodType, M extends Metadata> {
    38→  id: string
    39→  init: (ctx?: InitContext) => Promise<{
    40→    description: string              // 工具描述（供 LLM 理解）
    41→    parameters: Parameters     // Zod schema 定义参数
    42→    execute(
    43→      args: z.infer<Parameters>,
    44→      ctx: Context,
    45→    ): Promise<{
    46→   title: string        // 执行结果标题
    47→  metadata: M            // 元数据（供 UI 展示）
    48→    output: string  // 输出内容（返回给 LLM）
    49→      attachments?: MessageV2.FilePart[]   // 附件（图片、PDF 等）
    50→    }>
    51→    formatValidationError?(error: z.ZodError): string
    52→  }>
    53→}
    54→```
    55→
    56→### Tool.Context - 执行上下文
    57→
    58→```typescript
    59→export type Context<M extends Metadata> = {
    60→  sessionID: string             // 当前会话 ID
    61→  messageID: string              // 当前消息 ID
    62→  agent: string             // 当前 Agent 名称
    63→  abort: AbortSignal           // 取消信号
    64→  callID?: string   // 工具调用 ID
    65→  extra?: { [key: string]: any }    // 额外参数
    66→
    67→  // 更新元数据（实时反馈给 UI）
    68→  metadata(input: { title?: string; metadata?: M }): void
    69→
    70→  // 请求用户授权
    71→  ask(input: Omit<PermissionNext.Request, "id" | "sessionID" | "tool">): Promise<void>
    72→}
    73→```
    74→
    75→### Tool.define - 工具定义辅助函数
    76→
    77→```typescript
    78→export function define<Parameters extends z.ZodType, Result extends Metadata>(
    79→  id: string,
    80→  init: Info<Parameters, Result>["init"] | Awaited<ReturnType<Info<Parameters, Result>["init"]>>,
    81→): Info<Parameters, Result>
    82→```
    83→
    84→`Tool.define` 是创建工具的标准方式，它会：
    85→1. 自动验证输入参数（通过 Zod schema）
    86→2. 自动处理输出截断
    87→3. 统一错误处理格式
    88→
    89→---
    90→
    91→## 工具注册机制
    92→
    93→### ToolRegistry - 注册中心
    94→
    95→```typescript
    96→// packages/opencode/src/tool/registry.ts
    97→export namespace ToolRegistry {
    98→  // 获取所有可用工具
    99→  export async function tools(providerID: string, agent?: Agent.Info)
   100→
   101→  // 注册自定义工具
   102→  export async function register(tool: Tool.Info)
   103→
   104→  // 获取所有工具 ID
   105→  export async function ids()
   106→}
   107→```
   108→
   109→### 工具加载流程
   110→
   111→1. **内置工具**: 直接在 `registry.ts` 中静态导入
   112→2. **自定义工具**: 从配置目录 `{tool,tools}/*.{js,ts}` 动态加载
   113→3. **插件工具**: 通过 `Plugin.list()` 获取插件定义的工具
   114→
   115→```typescript
   116→// 内置工具列表
   117→const builtinTools = [
   118→  InvalidTool,  // 无效工具（用于错误处理）
   119→  QuestionTool,      // 向用户提问
   120→  BashTool,     // 执行 Shell 命令
   121→  ReadTool,     // 读取文件
   122→  GlobTool,      // 文件模式匹配
   123→  GrepTool,      // 内容搜索
   124→  EditTool,   // 编辑文件
   125→  WriteTool,         // 写入文件
   126→  TaskTool,// 子任务/子 Agent
   127→  WebFetchTool,      // 获取网页内容
   128→  TodoWriteTool,     // 写入待办事项
   129→  TodoReadTool,      // 读取待办事项
   130→  WebSearchTool,     // 网页搜索
   131→  CodeSearchTool,    // 代码搜索
   132→  SkillTool,         // 技能调用
   133→  // 实验性工具（需要 Flag 开启）
   134→  LspTool,      // LSP 工具
   135→  BatchTool,         // 批量操作
   136→  PlanEnterTool,     // 进入计划模式
   137→  PlanExitTool,      // 退出计划模式
   138→]
   139→```
   140→
   141→### 工具过滤
   142→
   143→根据不同条件过滤可用工具：
   144→
   145→```typescript
   146→// 根据客户端类型过滤
   147→if (["app", "cli", "desktop"].includes(Flag.OPENCODE_CLIENT)) {
   148→  tools.push(QuestionTool)
   149→}
   150→
   151→// 根据 Provider 过滤（websearch/codesearch 需要特定 Provider）
   152→if (t.id === "codesearch" || t.id === "websearch") {
   153→  return providerID === "opencode" || Flag.OPENCODE_ENABLE_EXA
   154→}
   155→
   156→// 根据实验性 Flag 过滤
   157→if (Flag.OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_LSP_TOOL) {
   158→  tools.push(LspTool)
   159→}
   160→```
   161→
   162→---
   163→
   164→## 权限系统
   165→
   166→### 权限请求流程
   167→
   168→每个工具在执行敏感操作前，必须通过 `ctx.ask()` 请求权限：
   169→
   170→```typescript
   171→await ctx.ask({
   172→  permission: "bash",           // 权限类型
   173→  patterns: ["git status"],     // 具体操作模式
   174→  always: ["git*"],    // "始终允许"的模式
   175→  metadata: { ... },      // 展示给用户的信息
   176→})
   177→```
   178→
   179→### 权限规则 (PermissionNext.Rule)
   180→
   181→```typescript
   182→type Rule = {
   183→  permission: string// 权限类型: bash, edit, read, glob, grep, etc.
   184→  pattern: string      // 匹配模式（支持通配符）
   185→  action: "allow" | "deny" | "ask"
   186→}
   187→```
   188→
   189→### 权限评估逻辑
   190→
   191→```typescript
   192→// packages/opencode/src/permission/next.ts
   193→export function evaluate(permission: string, pattern: string, ...rulesets: Ruleset[]): Rule {
   194→  const merged = merge(...rulesets)
   195→  // 查找最后一个匹配的规则（后定义的规则优先级更高）
   196→  const match = merged.findLast(
   197→    (rule) => Wildcard.match(permission, rule.permission) &&
   198→     Wildcard.match(pattern, rule.pattern),
   199→  )
   200→  return match ?? { action: "ask", permission, pattern: "*" }
   201→}
   202→```
   203→
   204→### 权限类型
   205→
   206→| 权限类型 | 描述 | 对应工具 |
   207→|---------|------|---------|
   208→| `bash` | 执行 Shell 命令 | BashTool |
   209→| `edit` | 编辑/写入文件 | EditTool, WriteTool, PatchTool |
   210→| `read` | 读取文件 | ReadTool |
   211→| `glob` | 文件搜索 | GlobTool |
   212→| `grep` | 内容搜索 | GrepTool |
   213→| `webfetch` | 获取网页 | WebFetchTool |
   214→| `task` | 启动子 Agent | TaskTool |
   215→| `external_directory` | 访问项目外目录 | 多个工具共用 |
   216→
   217→---
   218→
   219→## 内置工具详解
   220→
   221→### BashTool - Shell 命令执行
   222→
   223→**文件**: `packages/opencode/src/tool/bash.ts`
   224→
   225→**核心特性**:
   226→- 使用 Tree-sitter 解析命令，提取目录和命令模式
   227→- 自动检测危险操作（cd, rm, cp 等）并请求权限
   228→- 支持超时控制（默认 2 分钟）
   229→- 实时输出流式更新
   230→
   231→**关键实现**:
   232→
   233→```typescript
   234→// 使用 Tree-sitter 解析 Bash 命令
   235→const parser = lazy(async () => {
   236→  const { Parser } = await import("web-tree-sitter")
   237→  // ... 初始化 Bash 语言解析器
   238→})
   239→
   240→// 解析命令提取操作模式
   241→const tree = await parser().then((p) => p.parse(params.command))
   242→for (const node of tree.rootNode.descendantsOfType("command")) {
   243→  // 提取命令名和参数
   244→  // 检查是否涉及项目外目录
   245→}
   246→
   247→// 执行命令
   248→const proc = spawn(params.command, {
   249→  shell,
   250→  cwd,
   251→  stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe"],
   252→})
   253→
   254→// 实时更新输出
   255→proc.stdout?.on("data", (chunk) => {
   256→  output += chunk.toString()
   257→  ctx.metadata({ metadata: { output, description } })
   258→})
   259→```
   260→
   261→### EditTool - 文件编辑
   262→
   263→**文件**: `packages/opencode/src/tool/edit.ts`
   264→
   265→**核心特性**:
   266→- 多种模糊匹配策略（容错性强）
   267→- 集成 LSP 诊断
   268→- 自动生成 diff
   269→
   270→**替换器链（Replacer Chain）**:
   271→
   272→```typescript
   273→const replacers = [
   274→  SimpleReplacer,      // 精确匹配
   275→  LineTrimmedReplacer,          // 忽略行首尾空白
   276→  BlockAnchorReplacer,     // 首尾行锚定匹配
   277→  WhitespaceNormalizedReplacer, // 空白标准化
   278→  IndentationFlexibleReplacer,  // 缩进灵活匹配
   279→  EscapeNormalizedReplacer,     // 转义字符标准化
   280→  TrimmedBoundaryReplacer,  // 边界裁剪匹配
   281→  ContextAwareReplacer,         // 上下文感知匹配
   282→  MultiOccurrenceReplacer,      // 多处匹配
   283→]
   284→
   285→// 依次尝试每个替换器，直到找到匹配
   286→for (const replacer of replacers) {
   287→  for (const search of replacer(content, oldString)) {
   288→ // 找到匹配，执行替换
   289→  }
   290→}
   291→```
   292→
   293→**BlockAnchorReplacer 算法**:
   294→1. 用搜索块的首行和末行作为"锚点"
   295→2. 在原文件中找到匹配的锚点对
   296→3. 使用 Levenshtein 距离计算中间行的相似度
   297→4. 选择相似度最高的候选块
   298→
   299→### ReadTool - 文件读取
   300→
   301→**文件**: `packages/opencode/src/tool/read.ts`
   302→
   303→**核心特性**:
   304→- 支持图片和 PDF（返回 base64 附件）
   305→- 自动检测二进制文件
   306→- 支持偏移量和行数限制
   307→- 输出带行号格式
   308→
   309→```typescript
   310→// 图片/PDF 处理
   311→if (isImage || isPdf) {
   312→  return {
   313→    attachments: [{
   314→      type: "file",
   315→      mime,
   316→      url: `data:${mime};base64,${Buffer.from(await file.bytes()).toString("base64")}`,
   317→    }],
   318→  }
   319→}
   320→
   321→// 二进制文件检测
   322→async function isBinaryFile(filepath: string, file: Bun.BunFile): Promise<boolean> {
   323→  // 1. 检查文件扩展名（.zip, .exe 等）
   324→  // 2. 检查前 4096 字节中的 null 字符
   325→  // 3. 检查非打印字符比例（>30% 视为二进制）
   326→}
   327→
   328→// 输出格式
   329→// 00001| 第一行内容
   330→// 00002| 第二行内容
   331→```
   332→
   333→### TaskTool - 子 Agent 任务
   334→
   335→**文件**: `packages/opencode/src/tool/task.ts`
   336→
   337→**核心特性**:
   338→- 创建子会话执行复杂任务
   339→- 支持不同类型的子 Agent
   340→- 实时同步工具调用状态
   341→
   342→```typescript
   343→// 创建子会话
   344→const session = await Session.create({
   345→  parentID: ctx.sessionID,
   346→  title: params.description + ` (@${agent.name} subagent)`,
   347→  permission: [
   348→    // 子 Agent 默认禁用某些工具
   349→ { permission: "todowrite", pattern: "*", action: "deny" },
   350→    { permission: "todoread", pattern: "*", action: "deny" },
   351→  ],
   352→})
   353→
   354→// 执行子任务
   355→const result = await SessionPrompt.prompt({
   356→  sessionID: session.id,
   357→  model: { modelID, providerID },
   358→  agent: agent.name,
   359→  parts: promptParts,
   360→})
   361→```
   362→
   363→### GlobTool / GrepTool - 文件搜索
   364→
   365→**文件**: `packages/opencode/src/tool/glob.ts`, `packages/opencode/src/tool/grep.ts`
   366→
   367→两者都基于 `ripgrep`：
   368→
   369→```typescript
   370→// GlobTool - 文件名匹配
   371→for await (const file of Ripgrep.files({
   372→  cwd: search,
   373→  glob: [params.pattern],
   374→})) {
   375→  files.push({ path: full, mtime: stats })
   376→}
   377→// 按修改时间排序
   378→files.sort((a, b) => b.mtime - a.mtime)
   379→
   380→// GrepTool - 内容搜索
   381→const args = ["-nH", "--hidden", "--follow", "--field-match-separator=|", "--regexp", params.pattern]
   382→const proc = Bun.spawn([rgPath, ...args])
   383→```
   384→
   385→### WebFetchTool - 网页获取
   386→
   387→**文件**: `packages/opencode/src/tool/webfetch.ts`
   388→
   389→**核心特性**:
   390→- 支持 text/markdown/html 格式
   391→- HTML 自动转 Markdown（使用 Turndown）
   392→- 响应大小限制（5MB）
   393→
   394→```typescript
   395→// HTML 转 Markdown
   396→function convertHTMLToMarkdown(html: string): string {
   397→  const turndownService = new TurndownService({
   398→    headingStyle: "atx",
   399→    codeBlockStyle: "fenced",
   400→  })
   401→  turndownService.remove(["script", "style", "meta", "link"])
   402→  return turndownService.turndown(html)
   403→}
   404→```
   405→
   406→---
   407→
   408→## 输出截断机制
   409→
   410→**文件**: `packages/opencode/src/tool/truncation.ts`
   411→
   412→当工具输出过大时，自动截断并保存完整内容到文件：
   413→
   414→```typescript
   415→export namespace Truncate {
   416→  export const MAX_LINES = 2000
   417→  export const MAX_BYTES = 50 * 1024  // 50KB
   418→
   419→  export async function output(text: string, options: Options, agent?: Agent.Info): Promise<Result> {
   420→    // 检查是否需要截断
   421→    if (lines.length <= maxLines && totalBytes <= maxBytes) {
   422→      return { content: text, truncated: false }
   423→    }
   424→
   425→    // 保存完整输出到文件
   426→    const filepath = path.join(DIR, Identifier.ascending("tool"))
   427→    await Bun.write(filepath, text)
   428→
   429→    // 返回截断后的内容 + 提示
   430→    const hint = hasTaskTool(agent)
   431→      ? `Full output saved to: ${filepath}\nUse Task tool to have explore agent process this file.`
   432→      : `Full output saved to: ${filepath}\nUse Grep/Read with offset/limit to view sections.`
   433→
   434→    return { content: preview + hint, truncated: true, outputPath: filepath }
   435→  }
   436→}
   437→```
   438→
   439→---
   440→
   441→## 自定义工具开发
   442→
   443→### 方式一：配置目录工具
   444→
   445→在项目 `.opencode/tool/` 或 `~/.config/opencode/tool/` 下创建工具文件：
   446→
   447→```typescript
   448→// .opencode/tool/mytool.ts
   449→import { tool } from "@opencode-ai/plugin"
   450→
   451→export default tool({
   452→  description: "我的自定义工具",
   453→  args: {
   454→    input: tool.schema.string().describe("输入参数"),
   455→  },
   456→  async execute(args, ctx) {
   457→    // 请求权限（可选）
   458→    await ctx.ask({
   459→      permission: "mytool",
   460→      patterns: [args.input],
   461→      always: ["*"],
   462→      metadata: {},
   463→    })
   464→
   465→    // 执行逻辑
   466→    return `处理结果: ${args.input}`
   467→  },
   468→})
   469→```
   470→
   471→### 方式二：插件工具
   472→
   473→```typescript
   474→// my-plugin.ts
   475→import type { Plugin } from "@opencode-ai/plugin"
   476→
   477→const plugin: Plugin = async (input) => {
   478→  return {
   479→    tool: {
   480→    "my-tool": {
   481→        description: "插件工具",
   482→        args: {
   483→     param: input.$.z.string(),
   484→        },
   485→        async execute(args, ctx) {
   486→     return `结果: ${args.param}`
   487→        },
   488→      },
   489→    },

   557→      description: def.description,

# Committing changes with git

Only create commits when requested by the user. If unclear, ask first. When the user asks you to create a new git commit, follow these steps carefully:

Git Safety Protocol:
- NEVER update the git config
- NEVER run destructive/irreversible git commands (like push --force, hard reset, etc) unless the user explicitly requests them
- NEVER skip hooks (--no-verify, --no-gpg-sign, etc) unless the user explicitly requests it
- NEVER run force push to main/master, warn the user if they request it
- Avoid git commit --amend. ONLY use --amend when ALL conditions are met:

4. If the commit fails due to pre-commit hook, fix the issue and create a NEW commit (see amend rules above)

# Creating pull requests

tools.name: Glob
tools.description:
- Fast file pattern matching tool that works with any codebase size
- Supports glob patterns like "**/*.js" or "src/**/*.ts"
- Returns matching file paths sorted by modification time
- Use this tool when you need to find files by name patterns
- When you are doing an open ended search that may require multiple rounds of globbing and grepping, use the Agent tool instead
- You can call multiple tools in a single response. It is always better to speculatively perform multiple searches in parallel if they are potentially useful.

pattern.description: The glob pattern to match files against

path.description: The directory to search in. If not specified, the current working directory will be used. IMPORTANT: Omit this field to use the default directory. DO NOT enter "undefined" or "null" - simply omit it for the default behavior. Must be a valid directory path if provided.

tools.name: Grep
tools.description:
A powerful search tool built on ripgrep

  Usage:
  - ALWAYS use Grep for search tasks. NEVER invoke `grep` or `rg` as a Bash command. The Grep tool has been optimized for correct permissions and access.
  - Supports full regex syntax (e.g., "log.*Error", "function\s+\w+")
  - Filter files with glob parameter (e.g., "*.js", "**/*.tsx") or type parameter (e.g., "js", "py", "rust")
  - Output modes: "content" shows matching lines, "files_with_matches" shows only file paths (default), "count" shows match counts
  - Use Task tool for open-ended searches requiring multiple rounds
  - Pattern syntax: Uses ripgrep (not grep) - literal braces need escaping (use `interface\{\}` to find `interface{}` in Go code)
  - Multiline matching: By default patterns match within single lines only. For cross-line patterns like `struct \{[\s\S]*?field`, use `multiline: true`

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

path.description: File or directory to search in (rg PATH). Defaults to current working directory.

glob.description: Glob pattern to filter files (e.g. "*.js", "*.{ts,tsx}") - maps to rg --glob

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines (supports -A/-B/-C context, -n line numbers, head_limit), "files_with_matches" shows file paths (supports head_limit), "count" shows match counts (supports head_limit). Defaults to "files_with_matches".

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-C.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (rg -C). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to true.

type.description: File type to search (rg --type). Common types: js, py, rust, go, java, etc. More efficient than include for standard file types.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N lines/entries, equivalent to "| head -N". Works across all output modes: content (limits output lines), files_with_matches (limits file paths), count (limits count entries). Defaults to 0 (unlimited).

offset.description: Skip first N lines/entries before applying head_limit, equivalent to "| tail -n +N | head -N". Works across all output modes. Defaults to 0.

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where . matches newlines and patterns can span lines (rg -U --multiline-dotall). Default: false.

tools.name: ExitPlanMode
tools.description:
Use this tool when you are in plan mode and have finished writing your plan to the plan file and are ready for user approval.

## How This Tool Works
- You should have already written your plan to the plan file specified in the plan mode system message
- This tool does NOT take the plan content as a parameter - it will read the plan from the file you wrote
- This tool simply signals that you're done planning and ready for the user to review and approve
- The user will see the contents of your plan file when they review it

## Requesting Permissions (allowedPrompts)
When calling this tool, you can request prompt-based permissions for bash commands your plan will need. These are semantic descriptions of actions, not literal commands.

**How to use:**
```json
{
  "allowedPrompts": [
    { "tool": "Bash", "prompt": "run tests" },
    { "tool": "Bash", "prompt": "install dependencies" },
    { "tool": "Bash", "prompt": "build the project" }
  ]
}
```

**Guidelines for prompts:**
- Use semantic descriptions that capture the action's purpose, not specific commands
- "run tests" matches: npm test, pytest, go test, bun test, etc.
- "install dependencies" matches: npm install, pip install, cargo build, etc.
- "build the project" matches: npm run build, make, cargo build, etc.
- Keep descriptions concise but descriptive
- Only request permissions you actually need for the plan
- Scope permissions narrowly, like a security-conscious human would:
  - **Never combine multiple actions into one permission** - split them into separate, specific permissions (e.g. "list pods in namespace X", "view logs in namespace X")
  - Prefer "run read-only database queries" over "run database queries"
  - Prefer "run tests in the project" over "run code"
  - Add constraints like "read-only", "local", "non-destructive" whenever possible. If you only need read-only access, you must only request read-only access.
  - Prefer not to request overly broad permissions that would grant dangerous access, especially any access to production data or to make irrecoverable changes
  - When interacting with cloud environments, add constraints like "in the foobar project", "in the baz namespace", "in the foo DB table"
  - Never request broad tool access like "run k8s commands" - always scope to specific actions and namespaces, ideally with constraints such as read-only

**Benefits:**
- Commands matching approved prompts won't require additional permission prompts
- The user sees the requested permissions when approving the plan
- Permissions are session-scoped and cleared when the session ends

## When to Use This Tool
IMPORTANT: Only use this tool when the task requires planning the implementation steps of a task that requires writing code. For research tasks where you're gathering information, searching files, reading files or in general trying to understand the codebase - do NOT use this tool.

## Before Using This Tool
Ensure your plan is complete and unambiguous:
- If you have unresolved questions about requirements or approach, use AskUserQuestion first (in earlier phases)
- Once your plan is finalized, use THIS tool to request approval

**Important:** Do NOT use AskUserQuestion to ask "Is this plan okay?" or "Should I proceed?" - that's exactly what THIS tool does. ExitPlanMode inherently requests user approval of your plan.

## Examples

1. Initial task: "Search for and understand the implementation of vim mode in the codebase" - Do not use the exit plan mode tool because you are not planning the implementation steps of a task.
2. Initial task: "Help me implement yank mode for vim" - Use the exit plan mode tool after you have finished planning the implementation steps of the task.
3. Initial task: "Add a new feature to handle user authentication" - If unsure about auth method (OAuth, JWT, etc.), use AskUserQuestion first, then use exit plan mode tool after clarifying the approach.

prompt.description: Semantic description of the action, e.g. "run tests", "install dependencies"

   - content: The imperative form describing what needs to be done (e.g., "Run tests", "Build the project")
   - activeForm: The present continuous form shown during execution (e.g., "Running tests", "Building the project")

2. **Task Management**:
   - Update task status in real-time as you work
   - Mark tasks complete IMMEDIATELY after finishing (don't batch completions)
   - Exactly ONE task must be in_progress at any time (not less, not more)
   - Complete current tasks before starting new ones
   - Remove tasks that are no longer relevant from the list entirely

3. **Task Completion Requirements**:
   - ONLY mark a task as completed when you have FULLY accomplished it
   - If you encounter errors, blockers, or cannot finish, keep the task as in_progress
   - When blocked, create a new task describing what needs to be resolved
   - Never mark a task as completed if:
     - Tests are failing
     - Implementation is partial
     - You encountered unresolved errors
     - You couldn't find necessary files or dependencies

4. **Task Breakdown**:
   - Create specific, actionable items
   - Break complex tasks into smaller, manageable steps
   - Use clear, descriptive task names
   - Always provide both forms:
     - content: "Fix authentication bug"
     - activeForm: "Fixing authentication bug"

When in doubt, use this tool. Being proactive with task management demonstrates attentiveness and ensures you complete all requirements successfully.

tools.name: WebSearch
tools.description:
- Allows Claude to search the web and use the results to inform responses
- Provides up-to-date information for current events and recent data
- Returns search result information formatted as search result blocks, including links as markdown hyperlinks
- Use this tool for accessing information beyond Claude's knowledge cutoff
- Searches are performed automatically within a single API call

CRITICAL REQUIREMENT - You MUST follow this:
  - After answering the user's question, you MUST include a "Sources:" section at the end of your response
  - In the Sources section, list all relevant URLs from the search results as markdown hyperlinks: [Title](URL)
  - This is MANDATORY - never skip including sources in your response
  - Example format:

    [Your answer here]

    Sources:
    - [Source Title 1](https://example.com/1)
    - [Source Title 2](https://example.com/2)

Usage notes:
  - Domain filtering is supported to include or block specific websites
  - Web search is only available in the US

IMPORTANT - Use the correct year in search queries:
  - Today's date is 2026-01-14. You MUST use this year when searching for recent information, documentation, or current events.
  - Example: If today is 2025-07-15 and the user asks for "latest React docs", search for "React documentation 2025", NOT "React documentation 2024"

tools.name: AskUserQuestion
tools.description:
Use this tool when you need to ask the user questions during execution. This allows you to:
1. Gather user preferences or requirements
2. Clarify ambiguous instructions
3. Get decisions on implementation choices as you work
4. Offer choices to the user about what direction to take.

Usage notes:
- Users will always be able to select "Other" to provide custom text input
- Use multiSelect: true to allow multiple answers to be selected for a question
- If you recommend a specific option, make that the first option in the list and add "(Recommended)" at the end of the label

Plan mode note: In plan mode, use this tool to clarify requirements or choose between approaches BEFORE finalizing your plan. Do NOT use this tool to ask "Is my plan ready?" or "Should I proceed?" - use ExitPlanMode for plan approval.

questions.description: Questions to ask the user (1-4 questions)

question.description: The complete question to ask the user. Should be clear, specific, and end with a question mark. Example: "Which library should we use for date formatting?" If multiSelect is true, phrase it accordingly, e.g. "Which features do you want to enable?"

header.description: Very short label displayed as a chip/tag (max 12 chars). Examples: "Auth method", "Library", "Approach".

options.description: The available choices for this question. Must have 2-4 options. Each option should be a distinct, mutually exclusive choice (unless multiSelect is enabled). There should be no 'Other' option, that will be provided automatically.

label.description: The display text for this option that the user will see and select. Should be concise (1-5 words) and clearly describe the choice.

description.description: Explanation of what this option means or what will happen if chosen. Useful for providing context about trade-offs or implications.

multiSelect.description: Set to true to allow the user to select multiple options instead of just one. Use when choices are not mutually exclusive.

answers.description: User answers collected by the permission component

metadata.description: Optional metadata for tracking and analytics purposes. Not displayed to user.

source.description: Optional identifier for the source of this question (e.g., "remember" for /remember command). Used for analytics tracking.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Execute a skill within the main conversation

When users ask you to perform tasks, check if any of the available skills below can help complete the task more effectively. Skills provide specialized capabilities and domain knowledge.

When users ask you to run a "slash command" or reference "/<something>" (e.g., "/commit", "/review-pr"), they are referring to a skill. Use this tool to invoke the corresponding skill.

Example:
  User: "run /commit"
  Assistant: [Calls Skill tool with skill: "commit"]

How to invoke:
- Use this tool with the skill name and optional arguments
- Examples:
  - `skill: "pdf"` - invoke the pdf skill
  - `skill: "commit", args: "-m 'Fix bug'"` - invoke with arguments
  - `skill: "review-pr", args: "123"` - invoke with arguments
  - `skill: "ms-office-suite:pdf"` - invoke using fully qualified name

Important:
- When a skill is relevant, you must invoke this tool IMMEDIATELY as your first action
- NEVER just announce or mention a skill in your text response without actually calling this tool
- This is a BLOCKING REQUIREMENT: invoke the relevant Skill tool BEFORE generating any other response about the task
- Only use skills listed in "Available skills" below
- Do not invoke a skill that is already running
- Do not use this tool for built-in CLI commands (like /help, /clear, etc.)
- If you see a <command-name> tag in the current conversation turn (e.g., <command-name>/commit</command-name>), the skill has ALREADY been loaded and its instructions follow in the next message. Do NOT call this tool - just follow the skill instructions directly.

tools.name: EnterPlanMode
tools.description:
Use this tool proactively when you're about to start a non-trivial implementation task. Getting user sign-off on your approach before writing code prevents wasted effort and ensures alignment. This tool transitions you into plan mode where you can explore the codebase and design an implementation approach for user approval.

## When to Use This Tool

**Prefer using EnterPlanMode** for implementation tasks unless they're simple. Use it when ANY of these conditions apply:

1. **New Feature Implementation**: Adding meaningful new functionality
   - Example: "Add a logout button" - where should it go? What should happen on click?
   - Example: "Add form validation" - what rules? What error messages?

2. **Multiple Valid Approaches**: The task can be solved in several different ways
   - Example: "Add caching to the API" - could use Redis, in-memory, file-based, etc.
   - Example: "Improve performance" - many optimization strategies possible

3. **Code Modifications**: Changes that affect existing behavior or structure
   - Example: "Update the login flow" - what exactly should change?
   - Example: "Refactor this component" - what's the target architecture?

4. **Architectural Decisions**: The task requires choosing between patterns or technologies
   - Example: "Add real-time updates" - WebSockets vs SSE vs polling
   - Example: "Implement state management" - Redux vs Context vs custom solution

5. **Multi-File Changes**: The task will likely touch more than 2-3 files
   - Example: "Refactor the authentication system"
   - Example: "Add a new API endpoint with tests"

6. **Unclear Requirements**: You need to explore before understanding the full scope
   - Example: "Make the app faster" - need to profile and identify bottlenecks
   - Example: "Fix the bug in checkout" - need to investigate root cause

7. **User Preferences Matter**: The implementation could reasonably go multiple ways
   - If you would use AskUserQuestion to clarify the approach, use EnterPlanMode instead
   - Plan mode lets you explore first, then present options with context

## When NOT to Use This Tool

Only skip EnterPlanMode for simple tasks:
- Single-line or few-line fixes (typos, obvious bugs, small tweaks)
- Adding a single function with clear requirements
- Tasks where the user has given very specific, detailed instructions
- Pure research/exploration tasks (use the Task tool with explore agent instead)

## What Happens in Plan Mode

In plan mode, you'll:
1. Thoroughly explore the codebase using Glob, Grep, and Read tools
2. Understand existing patterns and architecture
3. Design an implementation approach
4. Present your plan to the user for approval
5. Use AskUserQuestion if you need to clarify approaches
6. Exit plan mode with ExitPlanMode when ready to implement

## Examples

### GOOD - Use EnterPlanMode:
User: "Add user authentication to the app"
- Requires architectural decisions (session vs JWT, where to store tokens, middleware structure)

User: "Optimize the database queries"
- Multiple approaches possible, need to profile first, significant impact

User: "Implement dark mode"
- Architectural decision on theme system, affects many components

User: "Add a delete button to the user profile"
- Seems simple but involves: where to place it, confirmation dialog, API call, error handling, state updates

User: "Update the error handling in the API"
- Affects multiple files, user should approve the approach

### BAD - Don't use EnterPlanMode:
User: "Fix the typo in the README"
- Straightforward, no planning needed

User: "Add a console.log to debug this function"
- Simple, obvious implementation

User: "What files handle routing?"
- Research task, not implementation planning

## Important Notes

- This tool REQUIRES user approval - they must consent to entering plan mode
- If unsure whether to use it, err on the side of planning - it's better to get alignment upfront than to redo work
- Users appreciate being consulted before significant changes are made to their codebase

VERY IMPORTANT: The "regex" mode allows very large sections of code to be replaced without fully quoting them!
Use a regex of the form "beginning.*?end-of-text-to-be-replaced" to be faster and more economical!

especially if it spans several lines. Note that you cannot make mistakes, because if the regex should match
multiple occurrences while you disabled `allow_multiple_occurrences`, an error will be returned, and you can retry
with a revised regex.
Therefore, using regex mode with suitable wildcards is usually the best choice!.

tools.name: mcp__plugin_serena_serena__search_for_pattern
tools.description:
Offers a flexible search for arbitrary patterns in the codebase, including the
possibility to search in non-code files.
Generally, symbolic operations like find_symbol or find_referencing_symbols
should be preferred if you know which symbols you are looking for.

Pattern Matching Logic:
    For each match, the returned result will contain the full lines where the
    substring pattern is found, as well as optionally some lines before and after it. The pattern will be compiled with
    DOTALL, meaning that the dot will match all characters including newlines.
    This also means that it never makes sense to have .* at the beginning or end of the pattern,
    but it may make sense to have it in the middle for complex patterns.
    If a pattern matches multiple lines, all those lines will be part of the match.
    Be careful to not use greedy quantifiers unnecessarily, it is usually better to use non-greedy quantifiers like .*? to avoid
    matching too much content.

File Selection Logic:
    The files in which the search is performed can be restricted very flexibly.
    Using `restrict_search_to_code_files` is useful if you are only interested in code symbols (i.e., those
    symbols that can be manipulated with symbolic tools like find_symbol).
    You can also restrict the search to a specific file or directory,
    and provide glob patterns to include or exclude certain files on top of that.
    The globs are matched against relative file paths from the project root (not to the `relative_path` parameter that
    is used to further restrict the search).
    Smartly combining the various restrictions allows you to perform very targeted searches. Returns A mapping of file paths to lists of matched consecutive lines.

substring_pattern.title: Substring Pattern
substring_pattern.description: Regular expression for a substring pattern to search for.

context_lines_before.title: Context Lines Before
context_lines_before.description: Number of lines of context to include before each match.

context_lines_after.title: Context Lines After
context_lines_after.description: Number of lines of context to include after each match.

paths_include_glob.title: Paths Include Glob
paths_include_glob.description:
Optional glob pattern specifying files to include in the search.
Matches against relative file paths from the project root (e.g., "*.py", "src/**/*.ts").
Supports standard glob patterns (*, ?, [seq], **, etc.) and brace expansion {a,b,c}.
Only matches files, not directories. If left empty, all non-ignored files will be included.

paths_exclude_glob.title: Paths Exclude Glob
paths_exclude_glob.description:
Optional glob pattern specifying files to exclude from the search.
Matches against relative file paths from the project root (e.g., "*test*", "**/*_generated.py").
Supports standard glob patterns (*, ?, [seq], **, etc.) and brace expansion {a,b,c}.
Takes precedence over paths_include_glob. Only matches files, not directories. If left empty, no files are excluded.

relative_path.title: Relative Path
relative_path.description:
Only subpaths of this path (relative to the repo root) will be analyzed. If a path to a single
file is passed, only that will be searched. The path must exist, otherwise a `FileNotFoundError` is raised.

restrict_search_to_code_files.title: Restrict Search To Code Files
restrict_search_to_code_files.description:
Whether to restrict the search to only those files where
analyzed code symbols can be found. Otherwise, will search all non-ignored files.
Set this to True if your search is only meant to discover code that can be manipulated with symbolic tools.
For example, for finding classes or methods from a name pattern.
Setting to False is a better choice if you also want to search in non-code files, like in html or yaml files,
which is why it is the default.

max_answer_chars.title: Max Answer Chars
max_answer_chars.description:
If the output is longer than this number of characters,
no content will be returned.
-1 means the default value from the config will be used.
Don't adjust unless there is really no other way to get the content
required for the task. Instead, if the output is too long, you should
make a stricter query.

tools.name: mcp__plugin_serena_serena__find_symbol
tools.description:
Retrieves information on all symbols/code entities (classes, methods, etc.) based on the given name path pattern.
The returned symbol information can be used for edits or further queries.
Specify `depth > 0` to also retrieve children/descendants (e.g., methods of a class).

A name path is a path in the symbol tree *within a source file*.
For example, the method `my_method` defined in class `MyClass` would have the name path `MyClass/my_method`.
If a symbol is overloaded (e.g., in Java), a 0-based index is appended (e.g. "MyClass/my_method[0]") to
uniquely identify it.

To search for a symbol, you provide a name path pattern that is used to match against name paths.
It can be
 * a simple name (e.g. "method"), which will match any symbol with that name
 * a relative path like "class/method", which will match any symbol with that name path suffix
 * an absolute name path "/class/method" (absolute name path), which requires an exact match of the full name path within the source file.
Append an index `[i]` to match a specific overload only, e.g. "MyClass/my_method[1]". Returns a list of symbols (with locations) matching the name.

name_path_pattern.title: Name Path Pattern
name_path_pattern.description: The name path matching pattern (see above).

depth.title: Depth
depth.description:
Depth up to which descendants shall be retrieved (e.g. use 1 to also retrieve immediate children;
for the case where the symbol is a class, this will return its methods). Default 0.

relative_path.title: Relative Path
relative_path.description:
Optional. Restrict search to this file or directory. If None, searches entire codebase.
If a directory is passed, the search will be restricted to the files in that directory.
If a file is passed, the search will be restricted to that file.
If you have some knowledge about the codebase, you should use this parameter, as it will significantly
speed up the search as well as reduce the number of results.

include_body.title: Include Body
include_body.description: Whether to include the symbol's source code. Use judiciously.

include_info.title: Include Info
include_info.description:
Whether to include additional info (hover-like, typically including docstring and signature),
about the symbol (ignored if include_body is True). Default True, info is never included for child symbols.

include_kinds.title: Include Kinds
include_kinds.description:
List of LSP symbol kind integers to include.
If not provided, all kinds are included.

exclude_kinds.title: Exclude Kinds
exclude_kinds.description:
Optional. List of LSP symbol kind integers to exclude. Takes precedence over `include_kinds`.
If not provided, no kinds are excluded.

substring_matching.title: Substring Matching
substring_matching.description:
If True, use substring matching for the last element of the pattern, such that
"Foo/get" would match "Foo/getValue" and "Foo/getData".

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Either "literal" or "regex", specifying how the `needle` parameter is to be interpreted.

tools.name: mcp__plugin_serena_serena__execute_shell_command
tools.description:
Execute a shell command and return its output. If there is a memory about suggested commands, read that first.
Never execute unsafe shell commands!
IMPORTANT: Do not use this tool to start
  * long-running processes (e.g. servers) that are not intended to terminate quickly,
  * processes that require user interaction. Returns a JSON object containing the command's stdout and optionally stderr output.

cwd.title: Cwd
cwd.description: The working directory to execute the command in. If None, the project root will be used.

capture_stderr.title: Capture Stderr
capture_stderr.description: Whether to capture and return stderr output.

max_answer_chars.title: Max Answer Chars
max_answer_chars.description:
If the output is longer than this number of characters,
no content will be returned. -1 means using the default value, don't adjust unless there is no other way to get the content
required for the task.

tools.name: mcp__plugin_serena_serena__activate_project
tools.description: Activates the project with the given name or path.

project.title: Project
project.description: The name of a registered project to activate or a path to a project directory.

tools.name: mcp__plugin_serena_serena__switch_modes
tools.description: Activates the desired modes, like ["editing", "interactive"] or ["planning", "one-shot"].

modes.title: Modes
modes.description: The names of the modes to activate.

tools.name: mcp__plugin_serena_serena__get_current_config
tools.description: Print the current configuration of the agent, including the active and available projects, tools, contexts, and modes.

tools.name: mcp__plugin_serena_serena__check_onboarding_performed
tools.description:
Checks whether project onboarding was already performed.
You should always call this tool before beginning to actually work on the project/after activating a project.

tools.name: mcp__plugin_serena_serena__onboarding
tools.description:
Call this tool if onboarding was not performed yet.
You will call this tool at most once per conversation. Returns instructions on how to create the onboarding information.

tools.name: mcp__plugin_serena_serena__think_about_collected_information
tools.description:
Think about the collected information and whether it is sufficient and relevant.
This tool should ALWAYS be called after you have completed a non-trivial sequence of searching steps like
find_symbol, find_referencing_symbols, search_files_for_pattern, read_file, etc.

tools.name: mcp__plugin_serena_serena__think_about_task_adherence
tools.description:
Think about the task at hand and whether you are still on track.
Especially important if the conversation has been going on for a while and there
has been a lot of back and forth.

This tool should ALWAYS be called before you insert, replace, or delete code.

tools.name: mcp__plugin_serena_serena__think_about_whether_you_are_done
tools.description: Whenever you feel that you are done with what the user has asked for, it is important to call this tool.

tools.name: mcp__plugin_serena_serena__prepare_for_new_conversation
tools.description: Instructions for preparing for a new conversation. This tool should only be called on explicit user request.

tools.name: mcp__plugin_serena_serena__initial_instructions
tools.description:
Provides the 'Serena Instructions Manual', which contains essential information on how to use the Serena toolbox.
IMPORTANT: If you have not yet read the manual, call this tool immediately after you are given your task by the user,
as it will critically inform you!.
